name: Spotify
summary: Registering the app is instant, but Spotify has effectively closed general access: Development Mode allows 5 users per app (and the owner needs Premium), and Extended Quota is only for registered organizations with ~250k MAU. For most agents, plan to stay at 5 users.

composio.note: Composio lists this toolkit but you must bring your own OAuth app (client ID + secret) in a custom auth config.

capabilities.label: Read/control playback for you + 4 others
capabilities.why: Development Mode: 5 allow-listed users per app; the owner needs Premium

capabilities.label: Any Spotify user can connect
capabilities.why: Extended Quota: organizations only, launched service, ~250k MAU

steps.title: Make sure the app owner has Spotify Premium
steps.detail: Since Feb/Mar 2026, Development Mode apps stop working if the owner's Premium lapses.
steps.human: Keep Premium active on the owner account

steps.title: Create the app in the Developer Dashboard
steps.detail: Dashboard → Create app. Name and description appear on the consent screen. Add redirect URIs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback). You can have up to 25 client IDs, which share one quota.
steps.agent: Fill in the redirect URIs and choose Web API
steps.human: Accept the Developer Terms and create the app

steps.title: Allow-list your 5 users
steps.detail: Add each user's Spotify email under User Management. Anyone else gets an error at sign-in.
steps.agent: Explain the limit to users in your onboarding

steps.title: Apply for Extended Quota (organizations only)
steps.detail: Use the form from a company email. Criteria: a legally registered business, an active launched service, about 250k MAU, and availability in key Spotify markets.
steps.agent: Draft the application and a compliance checklist against the Developer Terms

launchToday: Ship to yourself plus 4 testers in Development Mode today.
Composio has no managed Spotify app. You need your own client ID.
If you need the public, treat Spotify as partner-only and design around it.
rejections: Applying as an individual (Extended Quota has been organizations-only since May 15, 2025)
Below the ~250k MAU bar or not yet launched
Use cases Spotify reviewers flag as not driving artist discovery or as automation risk

blockers.fix: Development Mode caps you at 5 allow-listed users per app. There's no self-serve way around it.
All your Development Mode client IDs share one quota since July 2026. Cache and batch calls.
The owner's Premium subscription lapsed. Renew it.

uncertain: Spotify doesn't publish Extended Quota review times.
The ~250k MAU threshold comes from Spotify's 2025 criteria. Agencies may be judged differently.
